title: Minimal Window
description: A clean browser window enters with restrained chrome, a focused hero message, and an asset-free product surface.

defaultProps.headline: A clearer way forward.
defaultProps.subheadline: Bring the important details into one focused browser experience.
lines: A clearer way to show your product.

title: Macos Window
description: A polished macOS-style browser frame presents a dashboard surface with a headline and measured product-tour entrance.

defaultProps.headline: A familiar frame, made cinematic.
defaultProps.subheadline: Show the workspace, metrics, and workflow without distracting chrome.

title: Tab Switch
description: Browser tabs cycle through hero and dashboard states so a product tour can explain multiple surfaces in one continuous shot.

defaultProps.headline: See the whole picture.
defaultProps.subheadline: Switch between product surfaces while the browser context stays constant.

title: Address Bar Zoom
description: A browser frame smoothly zooms from the address bar into a documentation surface, making the destination and detail both legible.

defaultProps.headline: Start with the right context.
defaultProps.subheadline: Use a focused zoom to move from destination to detail.

title: Window Stack
description: Three browser windows rise and fan into a dimensional stack, useful for showing related product surfaces or a sequence of evidence.

defaultProps.headline: Every surface, working together.
defaultProps.subheadline: Stack the product story without losing the browser frame.

title: Browser Popover
description: A contextual browser popover reveals quick actions over a stable page, clarifying a click-driven interaction without external UI assets.

defaultProps.headline: Small actions, clear momentum.
defaultProps.subheadline: Reveal the next useful action exactly where the user expects it.

title: Split Browser
description: Two browser windows enter side by side to compare a marketing surface and an analytics surface in a single frame.

defaultProps.headline: Compare the story in motion.
defaultProps.subheadline: Pair two browser states to make change and contrast immediately legible.

title: Incognito Mode
description: A dark incognito browser frame gives a privacy, security, or hidden-state story a distinct visual treatment.

defaultProps.headline: Keep the session yours.
defaultProps.subheadline: A dark browser state for privacy, security, and quiet focus.

title: Devtools Drawer
description: A browser product surface opens into a stylized devtools drawer with source markup, ideal for technical product stories.

defaultProps.headline: Inspect the story.
defaultProps.subheadline: Show the product and the implementation detail in one technical reveal.

title: Full Bleed Tab
description: Browser chrome compresses into a slim top bar while a full-bleed landing surface scrolls through a cinematic product statement.

defaultProps.headline: A complete digital world.
defaultProps.subheadline: Let the page become the scene while the browser context stays visible.
lines: A clearer path through the story.
